Episode 197. Red Clan (3)
On September 25, 1803, it had been about ten days since the Red Clan began their activities on the surface.
"Ha, these crazy guys... Can they really go crazy like this even as a group?"
Beract growled softly and sighed. Sitting with a grim face, the White Wolf Tribe and the Red Tiger Tribe were tightly arranged in front of him.
"What? Because warriors keep disappearing, you're scared and can't patrol? In this situation, do I really have to receive such reports from the raid leaders?"
The Beastmen couldn't answer, their gazes fixed on empty space. Their shoulders felt heavy and numb under Beract's anger.

It wasn't strange that the Beastmen fell into fear as more than two hundred combat tribe members who went on patrol disappeared without a trace in just ten days. Among the White Wolf Tribe, there were a few burning with a spirit of revenge and a will to fight, but that was it.
Even the White Wolf Tribe, who would be second if it came to combat, was mostly consumed by fear. Beract couldn't understand the fear of the lower ranks.

Because he didn't live in the average warrior's barracks. The Beastmen reached this point not only due to the eerie tales and the reality of disappearances originating from them, but also due to the faint body odor left by the Red Clan.

"I also know that average warriors have been disappearing recently. Yes, it's a strange event. But should you combat tribe members be so scared and broken down like this? I don't know who's doing this, but isn't the right mindset to find them and chew them up somehow? But these bastards don't answer."
"Ah, hey. Why are you making the kids thirsty. Can morale recover like this?"
A Red Tiger tribesman next to Beract said in a hoarse voice.
It was 'Badrei', the Red Tiger King. He had been living a reclusive life under the pretext of injuries until recently, but he had joined the Kinzello headquarters a few days ago.
"Badrei, you've been hiding and playing, so be careful with your words. The underlings are watching."
"Yes, yes, I will. But Beract, from what I see, this is not a common event. Why are you so dull now as before, huh?"
"What?"

"I'm saying, um! I smelled a very dangerous scent. While the great White Wolf Tribe warrior Beract was sitting at the desk and hmm! during that time, I thoroughly licked the kids' patrol area myself, and this is really not ordinary... that's what I'm saying."
Even though the voice kept being sarcastic, Beract just rubbed his forehead as if annoyed, he didn't try to correct Badrei's attitude more strongly.
Because he was a warrior standing on an equal footing with him. Hiding and doing something made him much stronger than before.
"What do you want to say?"
"It's the work of the Bright Clan."
"What?"

"The ones who disappeared, they just vanished! Sure, our guys are usually weak against the strong and strong against the weak, but you White Wolves should be better, right? No matter how tough the opponent, you would have put up a fight at least once, but you didn't. What does that mean? Overcome with an unresistible fear, you were taken away like dogs who have met a veteran. The fight, the resistance, it just didn't take place. Who else but the King's Clan could do that?"

"At this point, the only human who can summon the King's Clan is the owner of the Rune Candle. Or perhaps the real Rune Candle himself could manifest the energy of the King's Clan. But that's not his style."

"Yes, yes. I also think that friend wouldn't do it. But who else but the King's Clan? There might be a renegade among the King's Clan he controls, or... another King's Clan exists in the world. It's one of the two."
"Renegade..."
Beract recalled Jin and his brothers for a moment.
He particularly remembered Jin. He couldn't imagine a traitor emerging from his faction.
"It's implausible, but the existence of another King's Clan seems more likely. Or maybe another strong being equivalent to the King's Clan."
"For one, the smell I detected was not something a human, dragon, demon, or monster could produce. It was a scent that only furry creatures like us can emit. It can't be a beast, right?"
Badrei was certain of the existence of another King's Clan.

"Starting today, let's patrol together. From what I can see, I think the border area 2 is likely to be hit today. It's the trajectory, the trajectory. I did a lot of this when I was young, so I know. We pretend to be weak and wait right there. Even if the real King's Clan comes out, surely the two of us won't lose, right?"
Beract wasn't pleased but agreed to join Badrei's plan for a week.
"Alright, it's settled! Our poor puppies can disperse and do their own things. This Badrei and the great warrior Beract will catch the guys who have been messing with our kin."
The beastmen watched for a sign, and as Beract nodded, they disbanded and returned to their places.
"Sigh, look at their deflated backs. Aren't the kids pitiful, Beract?"
"Maintain some dignity. You're the only hope of these garbage Red Claws."
"The Red Claws should be true to themselves. We're hoodlums from the root, unlike you guys. Very strong hoodlums."
"Both the chieftain and Grand Duke Zephyrin are in a coma. We have to behave properly not to look weak in front of the demons."
Coma.
Orgal and Zephyrin started showing unusual symptoms ten days ago and fell into a coma. It was because they were affected by the awakened Ameris, but Kincello still had no idea what caused it.
"Hmm, according to the demons, both gentlemen are not in life-threatening conditions. They presume it's due to mental shock? They won't stay down forever, will they?"
"Stop making such ill-omened remarks. The demons said there's hope."
"Don't trust those demon bastards too easily. From what I see, they're ready to stab us in the back anytime."
"I don't particularly like most of the demon clans, except for a few, but I trust you won't unnecessarily stir up trouble."
"Well, as long as you guys don't pick fights for no reason, ha ha! I'm looking forward to tonight!"
When night fell, they changed into casual clothes and started patrolling. Their physique and aura couldn't completely be concealed by the clothes, but still.
Several hours passed without any sign, but as soon as it hit midnight, the two felt a chill that was hard to describe.
"This feeling of chills going down my spine all of a sudden! You felt it too, right?"
"Quiet, it seems to be coming from over there."
The two exchanged a glance and simultaneously drew the great swords on their backs. As they swung their gigantic swords, the enemies hidden in the bushes revealed themselves.
The ones hiding were two soldiers of the enemy clan, awoken from the blood seal taken by Andorin and Ozen of the beast people.
"Ha! Look at this. What did I say, it's the Bright King Clan, right? But it's strange. The heart of the Bright King Clan is supposed to be blue, why is yours red?"
Berakt also noticed their hearts. It was definitely different from the hearts of Jin or his brothers.
"Moreover... you are much weaker than I heard?"
Badrei charged and swung his great sword, and the enemy soldiers were pushed back all at once.
They had not fully recovered yet. Initially, as foot soldiers, they were not a match for the two.

"Well, apart from being weak, they give off a scent that our guys would be scared of just by looking at them. The Bright King Clan is the Bright King Clan, huh. What are you? Did Jin Runkandel send you? Or are you acting on your own? Why is your heart red?"
In response to Badrei's rapid-fire questions, the enemy clan soldiers did not answer.
They were flustered by the unexpected situation. They were told by the second-grade warriors that hybrids of the human race would be paralyzed with fear just by approaching them.

Moreover, unlike the second-grade warriors, these two enemy clan members started their mission today, targeting the apex of the human combat clan. It was a mistake not to read their superhuman aura due to the lack of sensitivity.
"Don't want to answer? Well, can't help it! Come with us to the torture room... huh?"
Boom!
The enemy clan soldiers fired a flare.

"Shooting a flare in enemy territory? Interesting guys. Is it not a request for reinforcements, but to warn others to run away? We also have flares. We will catch the ones running away and send them all to the torture room together, don't worry, I won't leave you alone!"
Badrei also fired a flare to notify the gathering and encirclement. Now, in addition to the patrolling beastmen, the warriors and demons on standby at the branch would also swarm in.
In the meantime, Berakt swung his sword like a club and instantly smashed the enemy soldiers' lower bodies.
"Agh!"

"Ha, you're screaming over this when you've killed over 200 of our guys. Looking at you now, you're just like our enemy clan, aren't you? You're useless against stronger ones. I was unnecessarily scared because of your smell."
Thud!
Belract roughly slammed the Shadow Tribe members into the ground.
"When the kids arrive, let's catch these bastards and take them away. They'd better look forward to it. Huh? Demons may not know much else, but they are truly exceptional at torture."
"It appears that these are lower casts or hybrids of the Shadow Tribe. The Shadow Tribe members I've experienced personally were not as garbage-like."
"Hybrids or whatever, I'm honestly a bit disappointed, Bardrei. I was looking forward to a thrilling fight, but it feels unrewarding."
"As we uncover their purpose and who is behind this, more powerful members of their tribe will naturally emerge."
"Ah! I hope they are not as tasteless as these...."
Suddenly Bardrei, who had stopped speaking, had sharpness in his eyes.
That was because he felt the chilling sensation down his spine again. This time, cold sweat came out and his hands were shaking for real.
Belract also felt the same feeling a beat later. His whole body froze for a moment, giving him goosebumps.
"Release... our brethren."
From the opposite side of the bushes, a heavy voice was heard. The two did not shoot their sword aura towards it as they did just before.
Instead, they gathered all their energy and prepared for battle. An opponent of an unimaginable type, no,
A 'natural enemy' was emerging from the darkness of the bushes.
'Oh, shit... He's huge. What's this? Is he really the same subspecies of Shadow Tribe?'

As he saw the newly revealed Shadow Tribe member, Bardrei swallowed his dry spit. He was a giant who easily overwhelmed the two of them, who were notably larger even among the Beast Tribe and the White Wolf Tribe.
"If that's the case, return quietly today."
"...We cannot do that."
"Do you look down on me because I'm not in perfect condition, or are the hybrids bad in their heads as well...."
The Shadow Tribe member shook his head as if he found it regrettable and introduced himself.
"I am Rakiman Hog, the great warrior of the Shadow Tribe. It's been a long time since I've seen a hybrid refuse the mercy I offer."
"Great warrior!"
"Shadow King! Have you captured the spirits!?"
As soon as Rakiman finished speaking, reinforcements from the Beastmen and the Demons arrived.
And Belract, instinctively shouted towards his allies.
However, the ten members of the reinforcements who arrived first were already being sucked into Rakiman's palm. As if being swept into a whirlpool.
